diffs.diff: electrical conductivity (mS/cm): datasheet reading gives 5.882 per count, the part's model has 6.098
diffs.evidence: DFRobot's own DFR0300 library converts with '#define RES2 820.0' and '#define ECREF 200.0' and 'this->_rawEC = 1000*voltage/RES2/ECREF;' (voltage in mV), i.e. 1000/820/200 = 6.098 mS/cm per volt before calibration; the 5.882 figure is only the spec-table endpoints 0~20ms/cm divided by 'Analog Signal Output(0~3.4V)', not the vendor's conversion formula.
